ok.description: True only if every fork deviation either survived the merge or was legitimately obsoleted by upstream.

lost_deviations.description: One entry per fork deviation believed lost. Empty when ok is true.

file.description: Path of the file the deviation lived in.

why_lost.description: Why it is believed to have been dropped rather than legitimately obsoleted.

reasoning.description: Brief readable account of what was compared and how the verdict was reached.
